description.narrative: Novi put has been promoting education of girls, employment of women, encouraging women's participation in decision-making processes. Organizing grass-root campaigns, prevention and education activities, including potential and genuine victims, general public as well as representatives of relevant authorities throughout the country. While also holding a literacy course for youth in Sarajevo while also running a counseling center with specialized services for women and girls victims of all forms of violence and exploitation. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Continuous operation of the Help Line and the Counseling Center; - Provision of free-of charge psycho-social and legal counseling at a mobile Counseling Center (CC) throughout WHC and HNC; - Continuous awareness-raising campaigns throughout WHC and HNC; - Holding prevention and education lectures, workshops, roundtables - Lobbying and advocacy; - Online and media campaign; - Awareness raising activities in Roma communities.
